first_agent.prompt:
Build the top of the Choro Field Guide. Edit index.html ONLY, and do not touch any other file (styles.css, showcase.html, and stack.json stay exactly as they are). Do not add a framework, dependency, image, or new file.

In showcase.html there is a block marked between <!-- FIELD-GUIDE:TOP ... --> and <!-- /FIELD-GUIDE:TOP -->. In index.html there is a matching pair of FIELD-GUIDE:TOP markers around a placeholder <main>.

Replace everything between index.html's FIELD-GUIDE:TOP markers with the exact contents of that same block from showcase.html (the hero and the short script after it). Copy it verbatim — do not reword, restyle, or reformat anything. Keep the markers. Do not ask questions; finish quickly.

starter_task.title: Bring in the rest of the Field Guide
starter_task.description:
The top of index.html is built. Now bring in the rest of the page from showcase.html — the connected build strip, the toolkit section, and the footer.

In showcase.html there is a block marked between <!-- FIELD-GUIDE:BOTTOM ... --> and <!-- /FIELD-GUIDE:BOTTOM -->. Copy that whole block verbatim and paste it into index.html directly after the <!-- /FIELD-GUIDE:TOP --> marker (i.e. under the hero), before </body>.

Keep the existing hero exactly as it is. Do NOT modify styles.css, showcase.html, stack.json, or any other file, and do not redesign or rewrite anything. This is a straight copy — finish quickly, do not ask questions.
